name: plandown
description: Task manager that stores tasks, links, properties and time tracking in a folder of plain Markdown files.

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "for (const f of ['index.html', 'style.css']) require('fs').copyFileSync('src/gui/' + f, 'dist/gui/' + f); require('fs').copyFileSync('node_modules/mermaid/dist/mermaid.min.js', 'dist/gui/mermaid.min.js')"
